title: Where the ERW's datacenter facilities are
subtitle: Facilities by stated state and source, the 10 states with the most
source_line: Source: Bloomberg, Bloomberg.com, Data Center Dynamics, Data Center Frontier, Data Center Knowledge, Financial Times, Hart Energy, Heatmap News, Latitude Media, Natural Gas Intelligence, OilPrice.com, POWER Magazine, Reuters, WSJ, Amazon Web Services, Digital Realty, Equinix, ERCOT, Google, Meta, Microsoft, NYISO, Oracle, Switch, Vantage Data Centers via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table datacenter_facilities; data retrieved to 2026-10-25.
citations: ERW. Datacenter facilities: news, operator lists and ISO queues, deduplicated. Via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table `datacenter_facilities`, ERW commit ba88d85d6094.
facts: Of 433 datacenter facilities in the table, 271 state a US state; TX has the most, 45, then VA with 39 and CA with 36.
Facilities with a stated US state on 2026-10-25: 271.
